Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1995
ACT III OF 1995
PUNJAB HEALTH FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act further to amend the
Punjab Health Foundation Act, 1992
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th February, 1995]
No. Legis.2(10)/94/19, dated
13-2-1995.---ThePunjab Health Foundation (Amendment) Bill, 1994, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 8th day of
February, 1995 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 12th
day of February, 1995, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Punjab Health Foundation (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3 of Act XI of 1992

ACT III OF 1995
ACT III OF 1995
PUNJAB HEALTH FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act further to amend the
Punjab Health Foundation Act, 1992
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th February, 1995]
No. Legis.2(10)/94/19, dated
13-2-1995.---ThePunjab Health Foundation (Amendment) Bill, 1994, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 8th day of
February, 1995 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 12th
day of February, 1995, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 3 of Act XI of 1992.--(1) In the Punjab
Health Foundation Act, 1992 (XI of 1992) in section 3, after subsection (3),
the following shall be added:--
"(4)
Notwithstanding anything contained in subsections (2) and (3), the Government
may, at any time, reconstitute the- Board of Directors."

Repeal

3. Repeal.--The Punjab Health Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance,
1994 (XVII of 1994) is hereby repealed.
